title: "Fortnite's Cultural Moment Is Starting To Fade," Expert Says
content: Nothing lasts forever, and that includes Fortnite's "cultural moment," according to one industry expert. Researcher and industry expert Joost van Dreunen said on his blog that Epic's recent round of 1,000+ layoffs are further evidence of the "real-time collapse of American cultural dominance in interactive entertainment."
